fr.incident: Tentatives SQLi detectees sur des pages publiques. Le risque principal est l'acces non autorise aux donnees, le contournement de l'authentification ou la modification de la base.
responses: Bloquer rapidement les IP sources suspectes au niveau firewall ou WAF.
Verifier les logs applicatifs et SQL autour des URLs ciblees.
Controler les comptes et sessions administrateur apres les tentatives detectees.
improvements: Utiliser des requetes preparees pour toutes les requetes SQL.
Valider les entrees cote serveur avec des listes de formats attendus.
Desactiver les erreurs SQL visibles et journaliser les erreurs cote serveur.
Ajouter des regles WAF SQLi pour les pages login, search, product et track_order.

en.incident: SQL injection attempts were detected on public pages. The main risk is unauthorized data access, authentication bypass, or database modification.
responses: Block suspicious source IPs quickly at firewall or WAF level.
Review application and SQL logs around targeted URLs.
Check administrator accounts and sessions after the detected attempts.
improvements: Use prepared statements for every SQL query.
Validate server-side inputs with strict expected formats.
Disable visible SQL errors and log errors server-side.
Add WAF SQLi rules for login, search, product and track_order pages.

fr.incident: Tentatives XSS detectees dans des champs utilisateurs. Le risque principal est l'execution de JavaScript dans le navigateur, le vol de session ou la compromission d'un administrateur.
responses: Supprimer ou neutraliser les contenus suspects stockes en base.
Verifier si un administrateur ou un utilisateur a consulte la page infectee.
Invalider les sessions si un payload stocke a pu etre execute.
improvements: Encoder toutes les sorties HTML, attributs, URLs et JavaScript.
Filtrer les balises et handlers dangereux avant stockage.
Ajouter des cookies HttpOnly et Secure pour les sessions.
Mettre en place une Content Security Policy adaptee au site.

en.incident: XSS attempts were detected in user-controlled fields. The main risk is JavaScript execution in the browser, session theft, or administrator compromise.
responses: Remove or neutralize suspicious stored content from the database.
Check whether an administrator or user viewed the infected page.
Invalidate sessions if a stored payload may have executed.
improvements: Encode all HTML, attribute, URL and JavaScript outputs.
Filter dangerous tags and event handlers before storage.
Use HttpOnly and Secure flags on session cookies.
Deploy a Content Security Policy adapted to the site.

fr.incident: Tentatives Brute Force detectees sur la page de connexion. Le risque principal est la compromission d'un compte par essais repetes de mots de passe.
responses: Bloquer temporairement les IP sources qui depassent les seuils.
Verifier si une tentative a reussi apres plusieurs echecs.
Forcer la reinitialisation du mot de passe des comptes cibles si necessaire.
improvements: Ajouter un rate limiting sur login.php.
Activer un verrouillage temporaire apres plusieurs echecs.
Ajouter un CAPTCHA apres plusieurs tentatives.
Mettre en place une authentification forte pour les comptes admin.

en.incident: Brute Force attempts were detected on the login page. The main risk is account compromise through repeated password guessing.
responses: Temporarily block source IPs that exceed thresholds.
Check whether an attempt succeeded after multiple failures.
Force password reset for targeted accounts when needed.
improvements: Add rate limiting on login.php.
Enable temporary lockout after repeated failures.
Add CAPTCHA after several attempts.
Use strong authentication for administrator accounts.
